title: The 4 Best Blackout Curtains for Nurseries
h1: The 4 Best Blackout Curtains for Nurseries
metaDescription: Our 4 picks for blackout curtains for nurseries, with key specs, strengths and limitations for each, based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports.
lede: We looked at blackout curtains for nurseries using manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. Each pick lists what it does well and where it falls short, so you can match it to how you'll use it.

products.name: Exclusive Home Curtains Catarina Layered Blackout and Sheer Curtain Panel Pair
products.blurb: Key specs: 52 x 63 inch pair, hidden tab/rod pocket top, Layered sheer overlay over a solid blackout lining, Softer, more decorative look than a solid blackout panel.
strengths: Sheer overlay softens the look of the room during the day, useful for a nursery that doubles as a playroom
Blackout lining still blocks most light once fully closed
No cords, hangs from a rod pocket or hidden tabs
limitations: Layered construction blocks slightly less light than a solid single-layer blackout panel
63-inch length is short for taller nursery windows
features: 52 x 63 inch pair, hidden tab/rod pocket top
Layered sheer overlay over a solid blackout lining
Softer, more decorative look than a solid blackout panel

products.name: Lush Decor Sheer Grommet Curtain with Insulated Blackout Lining
products.blurb: Key specs: 38 x 84 inch pair, Sheer face fabric with insulated blackout lining sewn in, Grommet top.
strengths: Sewn-in lining means no separate blackout liner to buy or install
38-inch width suits a narrower nursery window without excess bulk
Grommet top glides quietly, useful for not waking a light sleeper while adjusting
limitations: Lighter colorways in this line block less light than a dedicated solid blackout panel
Smaller ratings base than the more established nursery blackout brands
features: Sheer face fabric with insulated blackout lining sewn in
Softer daytime look while still blocking light at night

products.name: Sun Zero Easton Blackout Grommet Curtain Panel
products.blurb: Key specs: 40 x 63 inch single panel, grommet top, Blocks up to 90% of light, Reduces energy loss through the window by up to 25%.
strengths: Available in soft nursery-friendly colors like blush and sage
Affordable enough to buy two panels per window for fuller coverage
limitations: 90% blocking means a single panel per window still lets in a visible strip of light
40-inch width is narrower than most nursery windows need for one panel to fully cover
features: 40 x 63 inch single panel, grommet top
Reduces energy loss through the window by up to 25%

products.name: Eclipse Palisade Blackout Curtain Panel
products.blurb: Key specs: 52 x 84 inch single panel, grommet top, Thermaback triple-weave blackout backing, Blocks 98% to 99.9% of light.
strengths: Blocks the most light of any panel in this list, best for a baby who wakes at any glow
84-inch length suits a taller nursery window without hemming
Wide color range includes muted nursery-friendly tones
limitations: Solid design has a more utilitarian look than the layered sheer-and-blackout styles
Sold per panel, so a pair costs roughly double the single-panel price
features: 52 x 84 inch single panel, grommet top
Reduces outside noise and insulates against heat and cold

howWeChose: Picks are based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. We don't claim our own testing.
We do not list prices or star ratings because they change. Check Amazon for current details.
